text:
Anna (Product): Quick heads-up — adaptive tool-calling + priority routing are GA on Hosted API as of today. Rolling to all regions over the next 6 hours. Docs + rollout checklist below. :party_popper:

Michael (Runtime): Huge — what are the new surface changes vs current toolcall v1?

Anna (Product): Two user-facing changes: 1) new streaming endpoint /v1/stream/toolcall-adaptive for combined streaming+tool calling; 2) request-level routing_priority param (values: latency, cost, balanced) that tells the router which variants to prefer. Backwards compatible with existing toolcall endpoints.

Sam (SRE): Rolling plan? Canary first? Any required migrations?

Anna (Product): Canary now (region us-west-2) for 1h, then gradual ramp. No client-side migration required — existing calls still work. We recommend switching to the new endpoint to get adaptive behavior. If you want to opt into priority=latency for critical routes, update the route config or add the header X-Redwood-Routing: latency.

Michael (Runtime): Runtime notes: fallback behavior will prefer compatible quantized model variants if preferred variant is unavailable. We added a routing-steer metric and a fallback-rate metric (router.fallback.rate). Watch those during ramp.

DeployBot: deploy started: hosted-router v5.12 -> canary(us-west-2) at 1832504820. Logs: https://deploys.internal/redwood/hosted-router/5.12

Sam (SRE): I'll add dashboard panels for router.fallback.rate, tail_latency_95, toolcall.error_rate, and queue_length. Setting alert if fallback_rate > 2% for >5m.

Elaine (Docs): I need the API examples and quickstart. Who owns the sample app changes?

Anna (Product): Elaine — assigning sample-app update to you. Key snippets are below. Please add a migration note and a short section on cost/latency tradeoffs.

Anna (Product): Example curl (streaming):
```
curl -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream/toolcall-adaptive \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-2b","prompt":"Summarize this file","tool_calling":"adaptive","routing_priority":"latency"}'
```

Michael (Runtime): Note: adaptive tool-calling will insert KV-cache hints for model variants — we increased the default KV retention to mitigate small perf regressions on first token. Ops change only.

Sam (SRE): Heads-up for support: new error code 4293 = routing congestion (suggest fallback to cost/balanced). Add to runbook.

Anna (Product): We've published the announcement blog + changelog. Links: https://internal.redwood/docs/releases/adaptive-toolcall-ga and https://internal.redwood/changelog#adaptive-toolcall-ga

DeployBot: canary completed: hosted-router v5.12 -> us-west-2 OK (1832505920). Next: staged ramp to us-east-1 at +30m.

Michael (Runtime): Will monitor runtime metrics and post periodic status in #incidents if anything unexpected.

Elaine (Docs): Got it, updating quickstarts and adding example showing routing_priority values and cost implications. ETA in 2hrs.

Sam (SRE): I'll create the alert runbook entry and post the support snippet in #support after docs are up.

Anna (Product): Thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you've completed your tasks. We'll follow up with a short postmortem-style note if any regressions during the ramp.

Michael (Runtime): :thumbsup:

Elaine (Docs): :thumbsup:

Sam (SRE): :thumbsup:

Anna (Product): Closing the loop here — GA rollout complete across regions at 1832508320. If you see user-impacting issues, ping me or @oncall immediately.
